text: 周一（10月5日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨4.04个基点，报5.3110%，日内交投于5.2475%-5.3472%区间，日内大约一半的时间维持微幅下跌状态、持稳于5.26%一线，北京时间16:00以来震荡上行，纽约中午逼近2002年二季度最高位5.4720%、2000年三季度顶部6.1820%，02:00以来回吐部分涨幅。 两年期美债收益率涨0.42个基点，报4.8289%，日内交投于4.7808%-4.8561%区间。 20年期美债收益率涨4.03个基点，报5.7089%，01:33达到5.7466%，时隔一个交易日再创新高；30年期美
text_en: Monday (October 5) New York afternoon, the US 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 4.04 basis points to 5.3110%, trading in a range of 5.2475%-5.3472% intraday, holding slightly lower around 5.26% for about half the session, trending upward since 16:00 Beijing time, approaching the Q2 2002 high of 5.4720% and the Q3 2000 peak of 6.1820% around New York midday, then giving back some gains since 02:00. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 0.42 basis points to 4.8289%, trading in a range of 4.7808%-4.8561% intraday.
